title: Drake vs. Kendrick
body: After the Kendrick vs. Drake feud, you want to answer: Who do UC Berkeley students listen to more?\nYou now decide to predict whether a student prefers Kendrick or Drake using design matrix $$X$$\nThis matrix has two features: $$X_1$$ is hours studied per day and $$X_2$$ is the number of music genres the student listens to.
